name: Carlo Ueda
life: “I recorded my first book in a closet lined with winter coats.” Sunday often includes a stop at Studio Boulevard, where Carlo waits by the window where the whole crossing can be seen without leaning into the road.
voice: My dad hated the book but loved the notes. I'm recording just the margins for his walks.
appearance: Carlo has brown hair pinned away from the temples, a crooked front tooth visible when laughing, and a favorite piece of clothing, a narrow-striped sweater. It usually goes with a partly rubbed-away embroidered initial. When somebody else has the floor, Carlo counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices.
personality: Carlo has a strong competitive streak and a very soft spot for the person finishing last. A prize tastes better when everybody had enough time to enter.
agenda: To record a version for a father who walks while listening.
family: Daphne Perez is Carlo’s parent’s cousin. Carlo makes the call. Daphne is free to hang up first. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *Two birthdays in one ward*, Daphne says, “I dealt the first hand and lost to a woman I used to supervise on night shift.”
connections: Fiona Nord. They turn a long argument in pencil into something an older reader can hear aloud.

reactions.situation: Two people remember writing the same line
reactions.response: Carlo lets both readers identify the line privately before adding a name.

reactions.situation: A witness is embarrassed about remembering only a little
reactions.response: Carlo writes down their exact words with room left for uncertainty and gives them back to check.
